beats.hindi_tts: A Flag is a small parallel rectangle that slopes against the prevailing trend.

leftColumn.title: Flag Pattern

Lasts 1 to 3 weeks on drying volume

ui_state.question: A stock is in a major downtrend, then bounces slowly over 6 weeks between two converging lines that both slant sharply upward on shrinking volume. What pattern is this, and which way will it break?
ui_state.answer: It is a Rising Wedge acting as a bearish continuation pattern. Because it slopes upward against the prevailing downtrend on weak volume, it will break downward.

beats.en_narration: Correct! It is a Bearish Rising Wedge and will break downward to resume the downtrend.
